{{Quote|Concert every night – call 050506.|Poster caption|<ref name="Concept" />}}
'''''Concert Every Night''''' was a [[Painting|poster]] put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time if the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in order to promote a series of concerts by a [[Unidentified Human singer|Human singer]]. The poster showed the singer performing on stage against a luminous multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] background. The yellow caption was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and read "concert every night"<ref name="LT" /> – "call 050506."<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-concept-art-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref> The poster appeared in [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], on a [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxi]], in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="LT" /> in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]],<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> next to a [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] used by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> and on a wall on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]].<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
